body.message:
I’d like to refer back to your message on 24 June, where you confirmed in writing:
“Rate for the next 03 months will be:
July - AED 5,500
Aug - AED 6,500
Sep - AED 7,500”
I accepted this and confirmed I was ready to proceed on this basis, and you replied “Well noted” 🤝. This was a clear, mutual agreement.
Now, before even reaching September, I’m being told the next extension will be AED 6,500 - but based on what was already agreed, August was already 6,500. If the rate simply keeps increasing every time I renew, this isn’t in line with what we agreed, and it isn’t fair.
Given the structure we already confirmed, I’d like to fix the rate at AED 6,500/month for the next 3 months, without further increases. This is a reasonable continuation of the pricing we already agreed on, not a discount request.
Please confirm this in writing so I can proceed with the extension.
Thank you.
